snippet.title: Realms at War Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Gameplay Trailer for Realms at War is here, showing off the current build of gameplay, world and units on offer.

Realms at War is a turn-based strategy game inspired by chess, where fantasy factions clash in PvP and PvE battles. Equip your forces, adapt to rogue-like challenges, and conquer diverse realms filled with ever-changing foes and environments.

Thanks for coming by to watch this video, consider subscribing!

Steam link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3138010/Realms_at_War/
